SELECT rb.reported_reserve_usd - COALESCE(rc.total, 0) FROM reported_balances rb LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS total FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-06-30') rc ON 1=1 WHERE rb.report_date='2025-06-30'

WITH jun AS (SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-06-30') AS reserve, (SELECT circulating_rlusd FROM reported_balances WHERE report_date='2025-06-30') AS circ), may AS (SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-05-30') AS reserve, (SELECT circulating_rlusd FROM reported_balances WHERE report_date='2025-05-30') AS circ) SELECT (CAST(jun.reserve AS REAL) / jun.circ - CAST(may.reserve AS REAL) / may.circ) * 10000 FROM jun, may
